_comment: Classifier fixtures modeled on real job-search email formats (ATS confirmations, OA invites, recruiter mail, digests). All names, links and ids are synthetic. 'category' lists every acceptable answer; 'application_id' is the tracked-app id the email must (or must not) link to.
